D022: Inappropriate compensatory behaviors accompany binge eating and are repeated regularly.
D023: Binge eating and compensatory behaviors are accompanied, but compensatory behaviors are one-off or not repetitive.

D022.key_difference: Presence of binge eating/inappropriate compensatory behaviors and excessive concern about body shape and weight

D022: Binge eating, inappropriate compensatory behaviors, and excessive concern about body shape and weight are accompanied by depressive symptoms.
D013: Binge eating may appear along with depressive symptoms, but inappropriate compensatory behaviors and excessive concern about body shape and weight are not accompanied.
